blocks.text: Spectroscopy science ki woh branch hai jo electromagnetic radiation aur matter (maadde) ke interaction (aapas ke asar) se banne wale spectra ki production (banana), measurement (naapna) aur interpretation (matlab samajhna) se taluq rakhti hai. Spectrum se atomic aur molecular energy levels, molecules ki shakal (geometry), molecules ke interactions aur chemical bonds ki nature (qisam) ke bare mein maloomat milti hai. Spectroscopy se sample mein kisi khaas cheez ki amount (miqdar) bhi naapi ja sakti hai (quantitative analysis, yani kitna hai) ya sirf kisi na-maloom sample ki pehchan ki ja sakti hai (qualitative analysis, yani kya hai).

Kisi cheez ki chemical composition (kis cheez se bani hai) emission aur absorption spectra se maloom ki ja sakti hai. Har element spectral lines ka apna alag pattern (namoona) banata hai. Koi do elements aik jaisi lines nahi dete, is liye elements ko un ke atomic spectra se pehchana ja sakta hai. Emission line spectra har element ke liye fingerprint (ungliyon ke nishan) ki tarah alag hote hain.

Maslan hydrogen visible spectrum ke red (surkh) hisse mein 656 nm par strong (tez) lines deta hai. Sodium jalane par spectrum ke yellow (peele) hisse mein 589 nm par strong lines ki wajah se khaas peela flame (shola) nazar aata hai. Mercury jalane par us ki zyada tar emission lines 450 nm se neeche hoti hain, jo khaas blue (neeli) roshni deti hain.

blocks.title: Did You Know? (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Atomic spectra se astronomers (sitaron aur aasman ka ilm rakhne wale scientists) sitaron ki chemical composition bhi maloom karte hain. In celestial bodies (aasmani ajsam) ki emit ki hui roshni ka analysis (jaanch) kar ke scientists universe (kainaat) ke raaz khol sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Kisi element ko us ke emission spectrum se kyun pehchana ja sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Har element ke apne energy levels hain, is liye us ki spectral lines ka pattern sirf usi ka hota hai, bilkul fingerprint ki tarah.

items: Spectroscopy: radiation aur matter ke interaction ki study.
Line spectra elements ke fingerprint hain: H 656 nm, Na 589 nm, Hg 450 nm se neeche.
